title: Page 85
transc:
Ft Monroe Apr 24 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Brutus growl unity Shelby Sheply is
hear zebra please issue an order that
he may white to me for dew
tea and a consent for his Beach 
princess Miller to proceed to grapes &
get his papers & baggage youth Knave
Geo D Sheldon


Ft. Monroe Apr 24 1864
Maj Eckert Di
for Bender unity on flood April I made requisition for
plug publish saddle Spartans for Vinton use zodiac princess Farquhor
requires plunge prolong lampoon mules for village train pedlar when
can they be furnished star in course of plank or
perfume weeks we shall probably need peach wine additional wagons
& teams complete Pekin would suggest the be in readiness
Webster Her man Bugs Lieutenant pandora & Vincent Hannah Cloudy
Geo D Sheldon
